outcome_evidence: The robot approaches and aligns with the upper drawer handle (frames 0–75, image and wrist_image), closes its gripper around the handle (frames 76–83, wrist_image), and pulls the drawer outward, exposing its sides and interior (frames 100–120, image and left_ego_image). It then releases and withdraws (frames 122–163, wrist_image); the drawer remains visibly open at frame 163 in image and left_ego_image. No failed acquisition or unintended disturbance of the surrounding objects is visible.
